# Joint Business Plan: Mewsli x our platform

## Overview
Mewsli launches 4 shortlisted SKUs on our platform. Terms below are negotiated.

## Targets
| Metric | Target |
|---|---|
| Shortlisted SKUs | 4 |
| Estimated monthly GMV | ₹37,844 |
| Estimated monthly units | 136.5 |
| Blended margin at current vendor costs | 15.0% |
| First order | 500 units, ₹1,13,519 at vendor cost before GST |
| Payment terms | 30 days |

## Investments
- Brand-funded launch marketing: ₹50,000
- Launch discount: 5% for the first 30 days, funded by the brand

## Promo calendar
| Event | Start | End |
|---|---|---|
| Listings live | 2026-11-13 | 2026-11-13 |
| Launch week: sponsored listings and sampling | 2026-11-13 | 2026-11-19 |
| Launch-month discount window | 2026-11-13 | 2026-12-12 |
| First sell-through review | 2026-12-13 | 2026-12-13 |

## Commitments and next steps
- Written order confirmation and PO acknowledgement from Mewsli
- Revisit margin and MOQ at the first sell-through review on 2026-12-13
